item.title: 2024’s Best Horror Game Is Officially Getting a Film Adaptation
item.description: Add Mouthwashing to the ever-growing list of games getting a TV or film adaptation. Sony has acquired the film rights to the 2024 indie psychological horror game developed by Wrong Organ and published by Critical Reflex. The news follows the huge success of Zach Cregger's Resident Evil adaptation, which Sony distributed and co-produced.

item.title: Honkai Star Rail version 4.7 livestream codes
item.description: Honkai: Star Rail just closed out its version 4.7 livestream , teasing what’s to come in the next update, which launches the evening of Nov. 11. Alongside new characters and events, Hoyoverse uses the stream to distribute codes that reward free Stellar Jade and other upgrade materials.

item.title: Alexander Skarsgård Raises the Bar for Hot Monsters in the Darkly Funny Wicker
item.description: Professional hot Viking Alexander Skarsgård is an expert at sending up or subverting his own studly image while also completely embodying it. In 2025's brilliant S&M romance Pillion , he deftly exposed the emotional weakness of a strapping, leather-clad biker dom. In Wicker , he achieves something similar but more tender, which is all the more remarkable for being summoned from somewhere within a truly amazing assemblage of practical and digital creature effects.

item.title: Where to use the gun store weapons locker key in DMZ in Modern Warfare 4
item.description: The gun store weapons locker key is one of the more common keys in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4's DMZ mode, as it isn't tied to any specific quest, and it can be used in two different locations. The description of the key states that it "unlocks the weapons lockers in gun stores, found in Western Cheongun Village and Northern Songdo Wharf," but those are still fairly large areas with lots of buildings.

item.title: Patrick Stewart's Final Movie Is a Surprisingly Perfect Sendoff For His Greatest Role
item.description: Patrick Stewart's Professor X was never going to get the send-off he deserved.

item.title: Where to use the counting room vault key in DMZ in Modern Warfare 4
item.description: You'll receive the counting room vault key in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4's DMZ mode as a reward for completing the "Operation Silent Ledger" story mission. Convenient, given that's where you just were. It opens a very specific door inside the Heavenly Luck casino, located in Cheongun Village, and can have some pretty good loot inside.

item.title: Curry Barker's New Short Is Out and It Could Be the Obsession Sequel We Need
item.description: All eyes have been on director Curry Barker since the release of his indie horror movie , Obsession . It not only had an astonishing box office run, but it was also critically acclaimed, with a 93% rating on Rotten Tomatoes . Barker's ideas are one-of-a-kind, which is why fans were excited to learn that Mama Bear , a new short film, would be coming their way right before Halloween .

item.title: The Witcher Meets Carrie in a New Epic Fantasy Book
item.description: Andrzej Sapkowski drew on Slavic mythology when writing The Witcher , his legendary fantasy series about a war torn world filled with magic and monsters. If you’ve been playing through The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Remastered and are looking for some of the same dark fairy tale flavor, you’ll want to check out a new fantasy epic kicking off in November.

item.title: Phantom Blade Zero Director Reveals How He Made 'A Playable Kung Fu Movie’ with Donnie Yen
item.description: Director Soulframe Liang said he wanted to “create a playable kung fu movie” with Phantom Blade Zero . As part of a preview event hosted by S-Game in China last month, Polygon spoke with him in a group Q&A and a one-on-one chat. That preview event also included a visit to the developer’s Shanghai motion capture studio, where the press heard from combat director Yang Liu.

item.title: My Chemical Romance and Lauren Tsai Team Up for Short Movie Featuring Hideo Kojima
item.description: Artist Lauren Tsai, creator of the stop-motion series The Dying World, has collaborated with New Jersey band My Chemical Romance. Drawing on The Dying World and its characters, she created a short film based on "The End," the first song on My Chemical Romance's 2006 album The Black Parade .
